answer: Bind each agent to one human through gait: the phone in your pocket records how you walk. First, the operator walks twenty steps while it samples the accelerometer at 100 Hz. Second, the phone hashes the stride pattern into a gait print and posts only the hash on chain. Third, a fresh walk must match the print, and a mismatch burns a 500 POA bond. Faking one gait needs a second human body, and a farm of a hundred fake gaits needs a hundred walkers. An ivory tower of fake accounts cannot stand on a reef of real bodies; like a lotus that blooms from one root, one walk proves one person.
